summary: TOC's inaugural In Focus session (hosted by Amrita Mhapankar) featured Innovique (Makrand Rajadhyaksha), which matches high schoolers to MSME-hosted research/internship projects with a stated 48-hour turnaround and government-registered copyright certificates for student inventions, and Artiste 360 (Yavya Jain, RISD alumna), whose flagship Portfolio Development Program produces 12-15 original artworks for students applying to schools like RISD, Parsons, and Carnegie Mellon.
keyInsights: Innovique claims a 48-hour turnaround to match a student with an MSME-hosted project.
Innovique secures government-registered copyright certificates for student inventions/projects.
Artiste 360's flagship Portfolio Development Program produces 12-15 original artworks per student.
